missing_dataset: Dated opening and closing market prices for every originated market
why_it_blocks: No residual, no closing line value and no vig decomposition can be published, and R-18, R-59 and R-60 all need one.
acquisition_route: Decide the price policy (S-02), then either license a first-party feed or publish the fair line alone with the market column blank.
clearing_number: one dated open and close row for >=90% of originated markets in >=2 consecutive weeks

missing_dataset: Official inactive lists for every game in the sample window
why_it_blocks: Without it, 'Questionable' cannot be calibrated and R-44 and R-53 cannot be answered at all.
acquisition_route: Capture the league's inactives article per game, or the game centre's inactives block, and join 1:1 to the designation rows.
clearing_number: one inactive list per game in the window, joined to the designation rows, with the play rate per designation and a confidence interval

missing_dataset: Official snap counts
why_it_blocks: Depth modelled from playing time (R-11) and the snap-count starter proxy (R-56) both need it, and it is route (b) of the depth decision (S-03).
acquisition_route: Read the NFL stats pages for a snap-count table; confirm it is machine-readable and storeable.
clearing_number: one official snap-count read per club-game for >=1 full season

missing_dataset: NFL Game Books (declared starters and game-day status)
why_it_blocks: 'Who actually started' is only provable here, and the availability graph (R-10) depends on it.
acquisition_route: Attempt a single dated read of a Game Book and record the result either way.
clearing_number: >=1 Game Book per settled game in the corpus, transcribed
status: open - host reported unreachable by prior sessions

missing_dataset: Official depth-chart pages for all 32 clubs
why_it_blocks: Fourteen requirements sit behind this, including the entire defensive-deficiency feature the owner asked for.
acquisition_route: Walk all 32 club depth pages, store the raw string, and name each failure club by club (S-03 option A).
clearing_number: 32/32 clubs parsed with the raw string retained

missing_dataset: An authorized structured depth source for the Texans
why_it_blocks: One club breaks the sweep, and a 31/32 depth register cannot support a league-wide feature.
acquisition_route: Search for a non-image authorized source (S-04 option A); if none exists, exclude the club and publish the exclusion (S-04 option B).
clearing_number: one parsed dated Texans depth capture, or a published exclusion with its reason

missing_dataset: Weekly injury-report archives for past seasons
why_it_blocks: The designation measurement needs several seasons of designations joined to outcomes.
acquisition_route: Run the retention job from S-06 and, separately, look for a backfill source for prior seasons.
clearing_number: >=3 seasons of weekly, dated injury archives

missing_dataset: Official 2026 rule text for kickoff and the declared onside-kick option
why_it_blocks: A regime prior built without it is a guess with a number attached.
acquisition_route: Read the official rule book or the league's rule-change announcement and quote it with a URL.
clearing_number: the rule text quoted with its source URL

missing_dataset: Official stadium roof / surface designation per fixture
why_it_blocks: Totals and passing props are mispriced when a dome is treated as outdoor.
acquisition_route: Capture the league's designation 90 minutes before kickoff, per the owner's requirement.
clearing_number: one dated official roof/surface designation per fixture for >=1 week

missing_dataset: NWS hourly wind and precipitation grids per stadium
why_it_blocks: The weather half of the same feature; it is the easier half.
acquisition_route: Read the NWS gridpoint forecast for each stadium's coordinates (api.weather.gov is an official US government source).
clearing_number: one gridpoint forecast per fixture, stored with the forecast issuance time

missing_dataset: A dated, machine-readable official transactions log
why_it_blocks: Roster turnover must be a first-class event (R-34) and stale depth rows must be flagged against it (R-46).
acquisition_route: Capture the official transactions page on a schedule and version depth against the last event.
clearing_number: one transactions capture per day, with the last roster event per depth row

missing_dataset: The league's dated schedule announcements
why_it_blocks: R-24 asks for the dated announcement beside the live schedule. What the page carries is a standing procedure note, not a dated announcement.
acquisition_route: Watch for the league's dated announcements for Weeks 16, 17 and 18 and capture each when published.
clearing_number: one dated announcement per change, stored with its publication date
status: partially open - a standing procedure note was captured, not a dated change

missing_dataset: Venue text from the official game centre for every fixture
why_it_blocks: Twelve of thirteen Week 11 venue strings currently come from a hotel affiliate link, which is not a venue field.
acquisition_route: Open each fixture's official game centre and transcribe the venue from its own text (S-19 option A).
clearing_number: 13/13 venues with direct on-page provenance

missing_dataset: The league's official definitions of Out, Doubtful and Questionable
why_it_blocks: Calibration needs the definitions as the league states them, not as the industry remembers them.
acquisition_route: Read the league's injury-report policy page and quote each definition.
clearing_number: all three definitions quoted with the source URL

missing_dataset: Pre-registration commit hashes for every strategy
why_it_blocks: Without a pre-window commit, pre-registration is a claim and not a registration.
acquisition_route: Write the rule text, the window and the gates, and commit before the window opens (S-10 option A).
clearing_number: one commit hash per strategy that predates the first kickoff in its window

missing_dataset: A settled results feed re-read at a dated commit
why_it_blocks: Every backtest and every proper score depends on it, and it has not been re-read this session.
acquisition_route: Re-read the official results pages for the whole corpus, storing the read date per row.
clearing_number: every corpus row carries a read date and the page URL it came from

missing_dataset: A written rights and terms decision
why_it_blocks: It gates automation, the public/private split, and whether archiving is permitted at all.
acquisition_route: Read the terms, then commit a dated decision naming the hosts, the rate and the republication rule (S-02).
clearing_number: a dated decision file committed to the repo

missing_dataset: An external durable snapshot store
why_it_blocks: Seven requirements ask for immutable captures outside the static site; none can be satisfied in the site's own repository.
acquisition_route: Choose S-01 option A or B and write the first artifact.
clearing_number: the first external artifact with a hash chain that verifies

missing_dataset: Operator void and push rules for parlays and prop combos
why_it_blocks: A combo cannot be ranked without them, because the settlement rule changes the payoff.
acquisition_route: Obtain the operator's written rules for each market the leaderboard would score.
clearing_number: the void/push rules in writing for every market scored

missing_dataset: A validated joint probability for each candidate leg set
why_it_blocks: The parlay gate (R-36) is shut until one exists.
acquisition_route: Estimate from paired residuals on a validated sample and publish the estimate with its uncertainty (S-14 option B), or keep the gate shut (option A).
clearing_number: a validated joint probability with an uncertainty interval, per leg set

missing_dataset: Official player-prop market definitions and settlement rules
why_it_blocks: Prop combos cannot be scored without knowing exactly what settles the prop.
acquisition_route: Obtain each operator's written prop definitions, or restrict the leaderboard to markets the league itself defines.
clearing_number: a written definition and settlement rule for every prop in scope

missing_dataset: The Week 11 injury report
why_it_blocks: Nothing about Week 11 availability can be verified until the league publishes it.
acquisition_route: Re-request /injuries/league/2026/reg11 on Thursday and Friday and record the result.
clearing_number: the request returns a page whose heading reads 'Injuries - WEEK 11'
